gallery.blurb: An endless Mandelbrot zoom into seahorse valley, rendered progressively on a coarse buffer with smooth escape-time colouring, the palette cycling with the music.
gallery.prompt: An endless Mandelbrot zoom into seahorse valley, rendered progressively on a coarse buffer with smooth escape-time colouring, the palette cycling with the music. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
